spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (शिलति)
To glean.

n. (-लं)
Gleaning ears of corn.
f. (-ला)
1 A stone, a rock.
2

Arsenic.
3

A flat stone on which condiments, &c. are ground with a muller.
f. (-ला-ली)
1 The timber of a door frame.
2 A transverse beam, or a beam or stone placed across the top of a post or pillar.
f. (-ली)
1 A small earth worm.
2 A dart, a spike.
E.
शिल to glean, aff. क.

r. 1st cl. (शीलति)
1 To meditate, to consider, to reflect profoundly and abstractedly.
2 To worship, to adore.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (शीलति शीलयति)
To practise, to exercise, (as the memory, &c.) to repeat.
r. 10th cl. (शीलयति)
1 To wear.
2 To have or be endowed with.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Possessed of, endowed with, practising, versed in, &c.
2 Behaving, conducted.
3 Well-behaved, well-disposed.
mn. (-लः-लं)
1 Nature, quality.
2 Disposition, inclination.
3 Good conduct or disposition, steady and uniform observance of law and morals.
4 Beauty.
m. (-लः)
A large snake.
E.
शील to meditate, to learn, &c., aff. घञ्; or शी to sleep, and लक् Uṇādi aff.

r. 6th cl. (सिलति)
To glean: more usually सिल.

f. (-र्णी)
The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)

m. (-कः)
A stone cutter's chisel.
E.
शिला a stone, कुट्ट to cut, aff. वुन्.

n. (-मं)
Storax: see शिलाज.
E.
शिला and कुसुम flower.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Firm or hard as a stone or rock.
E.
शिला, and घन thick.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced in a mountain or rock, fossile, mineral.
n. (-जं)
1 Storax or Benzoin, the resins of the Styrax benzoinum or S. officinale, which are usually confounded by the

Hindus.
2

Iron.
E.
शिला a rock, and ज born; the balsams being supposed to be fossile productions, and to exude from the soil of mountainous places; being confounded with bitumen or petroleum.

Bitumen.
2

Red chalk.
E.
शिला a stone, and जतु lac; it is supposed to ooze from the stones of mountains in the hot weather.

f. (-जित्)
Bitumen.
E.
शिला a stone, and जित् what conquers or excels.

m. (-कः)
1 A room on the top of a house.
2 A hole.
3 A fence, an enclosure.
E.
शिला a stone, अट to go, वुन् aff.

n. (-लं)
The surface of a rock or stone.
E.
शिला, and तल below.

n. (-जं)
Iron.
E.
शिला a stone, आत्मन् self, and ज born.

f. (-का)
A crucible.
E.
शिला a stone, आत्मन् substance, कन् aff. fem. form.

m. (-द्रुः)
Bitumen.
E.
शिला a stone, and दद्रु herpes.

Chalk.
2

Red chalk.
3 A white fossile substance; an aluminous earth of a white colour, and thence considered to be a sort of chalk.
E.
शिला a stone or rock, and धातु a mineral.

m. (-ट्टः)
A flat stone for grinding condiments, &c.
E.
शिला a stone, and पट्ट a flat surface.

m. (-त्त्रः)
A mullar or roller for grinding condiments, &c. on a flat stone.
E.
शिला a flat stone, and पुत्त्र child; also शिलापुत्त्रक.

n. (-ष्पं)
Storax or Benzoin.
E.
शिला a rock, and पुष्प flower.

n. (-कं)
A layer or table of rock or stone.
E.
शिला, फलक a plank.

n. (-वं)
Storax or Benzoin.
E.
शिला a rock, and भव born.

m. (-दः)
1 A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.)
2 A stone cutter's chisel.
E.
शिला a stone, and भेद what breaks.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of stone.
E.
शिला, and मयट् aff.

m. (-सः)
Incense, Benjaminor Olibanum.
E.
शिला a stone, and रस juice.

f. (-ल्का)
A medicinal substance said to be of cooling and lithonthriptic properties, commonly termed Silābāk; a sort of lichen or moss.
E.
शिला a stone or rock, and वल्क bark; also termed शिलावल्कल, शिलात्वच्.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Hail.
E.
शिला, and वृष्टि rain.

m. (-धिः)
Bitumen.
E.
शिला a rock or stone, and व्याधि sickness.

n. (-नं)
1 Benzoin or

Storax.
2

A stone bench or seat.
E.
शिला a stone or rock, and असन abiding or आसन a seat.

n. (-रं)
Iron.
E.
शिला a stone, and सार essence.

f. (-लिः-ली)
The lower timber of a door.
m. (-लिः)
The Bhojpatra or birch tree.
E.
शिल to glean, इन् aff.: see शिल and शिला, &c.

n. (-न्ध्रं)
1 The flower of the plaintain tree.
2

Hail.
3

A mushroom.
m. (-न्ध्रः)
1 A sort of tree.
2 A kind of fish; also चित्रफलक.
f. (-न्ध्री)
1 Earth, clay.
2 A small earth worm.
3 A sort of bird.

n. (-कं)
A mushroom, one growing out of cowdung, a fungus.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-दः)
Enlarged or Tropical leg; also श्लीपद.

m. (-खः)
1 A bee.
2 An arrow.
3 A fool, a blockhead.
4 War.
E.
शिली a dart, (a sting,) and मुख the face.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Like a stone or rock, as hard, &c.
n. (-यं)
Storax.
E.
शिला a rock, ढक् aff. and the vowel unchanged.

m. (-यः)
1 A mountain.
2 A high mountain.
E.
शिला a stone or rock, उत् up, चि to collect, अच् aff.

m. (-च्छः)
1 Following more than one occupation.
2 Gleaning.
E.
शिला gleaning, उच्छ to gather or glean, aff. अच्; gleaning a subsistence.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Livelihood gained by gleaning.
2 Extraordinary occupation.
E.
शिलोञ्छ, and वृति subsistence.

mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं)
Growing from or upon rock or stone.
n. (-त्यं)
Benzoin or Storax.
E.
शिला a stone, and उत्थ what grows.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced from stone or rock.
n. (-वं)
1 A superior sort of Sandal wood, either the white or brass coloured sort.
2 Storax or Benzoin.
E.
शिला a stone or rock, and उद्भव produced.

m. (-काः)
GARUḌA.
E.
शिला a rock, and ओकस् abode.

n. (-ल्पं)
1 An art, any manual or mechanical art.
2 A sort of spoon or ladle, used at sacrifices to throw the Ghee or butter into the fire.
E.
शिल to be clever or skilled, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made short.

n. (-कं)
A sort of drama: one exhibiting magical and mystical rites.
E.
शिल्प manual art, and कन् aff.; also read शिल्पिकं.

n. (-र्म्म)
Manual labour, handicraft.
E.
शिल्प, and कर्म्मन् act; also शिल्पक्रिया, &c.

m. (-रः)
An artisan, a mechanic.
E.
शिल्प a handicraft, and कार who makes.

f. (-द्या)
Art, mechanical or manual skill.
E.
शिल्प, and विद्या knowledge.

nf. (-लं-ला)
A work-shop, a manufactory.
E.
शिल्प art. and शाला a hall.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Manual, mechanic.
n. (-कं)
1

Handicraft.
2

A sort of drama; see शिल्पक.
E.
शिल्प, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ल्पी-ल्पिनी-ल्पि)
1 An artist, an artificer or artisan.
2 Belonging or relating to a mechanical profession or art.
f. (-ल्पिनी)
A drug or herb, a kind of grass said to be known by the name of Lahānasipi, and described as sweet and cooling, and bearing seeds of tonic and restorative properties; also शिल्पिका, &c.
E.
शिल्प art, and इनि aff.

nf. (-लं-ला)
A work-shop, a manufactory.
E.
शिल्पि an artisan, and शाला a hall.

n. (-स्त्रं)
A treatise or set of treatises on works of art.
E.
शिल्पि an artist, and शास्त्र book.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Disposition, quality.
2 Conversancy.
E.
शील, and त्व added; also with तल्, शीलता.

n. (-नं)
Careful study of the Śāstras or sacred writings.
E.
शील to meditate, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Of a good or amiable disposition.
E.
शील good conduct, मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Moral, steady, and uniform in good behaviour.
E.
शील, and वृत्त practice.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Well-conducted, of proper conduct or disposition.
E.
शील, and सम्पन्न abounding with.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Skilled, learned, conversant, exercised.
2 Having, endowed with.
3 Made or consisting of.
E.
शील to learn, &c., aff. क्त.

f. (-की)
The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
E.
see सल्लकी, the इ being substituted for अ.
